hashNotes.eventSha256: SHA-256 of JSON event lines joined by newline, without a final newline; verified against available baseline and after traces.
hashNotes.stateDigest: Copied from validation source field named stateSha256. Values are the repository hashState eight-hex-digit digest, not a cryptographic SHA-256. State digests are expected to differ because maps/deployment differ.

causalRejectedBowDownControl.method: Bounded opening-only diagnostic at aggression 0.58, current pre-restoration river geometry. Exact control results observed in diagnostic stdout, not saved as full replay files.
causalRejectedBowDownControl.explanation: Moving the bow south changes nearest-enemy preference between refugee stops (5,11) and (6,12); moving it horizontally preserves their equal north/south distance. Mission destination distance is equal at those candidate stops. Escort pull then carries other units with the refugees.
causalRejectedBowDownControl.relatedTraceCaveat: The saved fair-south trace also uses different allied starts. It illustrates the south-diverted failure, but is not the isolated bow-only control.
